answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable work bond for a full epoch before it can earn: the bond is small for one identity but ruinous across a thousand fakes, so a Sybil farm pays a velvet-gloved tax on every clone. Peers then run random spot audits, checking claimed work against a verifiable log; an opal badge is granted only after several audits pass, unlocking higher rewards, while umber marks flag accounts that failed an audit, freezing their payouts until a reviewed appeal clears them.
